answer: What keeps this honest is Certified bricklayer course record with bricklayers endorsement, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 704 fakes pay 704 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. A signal of doubt is healthy, a crystal of proof is required, and a nebula of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
